text.en: Conversion into a National High School. - The Makiwalo Integrated School in Barangay Makiwalo, Municipality of Mondragon, Province of Northern Samar is hereby converted into a national high school to be known as Makiwalo National High School.
Transfer of Assets and Liabilities. - All personnel, assets, liabilities and records of the Makiwalo Integrated School are hereby transferred to and absorbed by the Makiwalo National High School.

Appropriations. - The Secretary of Education shall immediately include in the Department's program the operationalization of the Makiwalo National High School, the initial funding of which shall be charged against the current year's appropriations of the Makiwalo Integrated School. Thereafter, the amount necessary for the continued operation of the school shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
Implementation. - The Secretary of Education shall issue rules and regulations that may be necessary to carry out the purpose of this Act.
Effectivity. - This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette.
